settings.heading: 12V emergency starting
settings.text: 500A starting current and 1,000A peak; engine reference up to 6.0L gas / 4.0L diesel.

settings.heading: Three airflow settings
settings.text: Brushless air duster with a maximum specification up to 105,000 RPM.

settings.heading: 7,200mAh / 26.64Wh
settings.text: Stored energy for starting, dusting and compatible device power.

settings.heading: A kit worth keeping close
settings.text: Smart clamps, air nozzle and a 2W emergency light for practical use.

settings.heading: Ready for compatible gas and diesel vehicles.
settings.body: For compatible 12V vehicle batteries, KP700 is documented for engines up to 6.0L Gas or 4.0L Diesel, with 1,000A peak and 500A starting current. A full charge is rated for up to 25 starts; actual results vary with vehicle, battery health and temperature.

settings.heading: Choose the airflow that suits the job.
settings.body: The brushless fan has three documented speed levels: 30,000 RPM for up to 18 minutes, 70,000 RPM for up to 8 minutes and 100,000 RPM for up to 4.5 minutes. Maximum specification: 105,000 RPM / 360W / 550g wind pressure.

settings.heading: Keep a phone or small device within reach.
settings.body: USB-A output supports everyday emergency charging at 5V/2A. Recharge KP700 through the Type-C port at 5V/2A in about four hours. Use the supplied USB-A to Type-C cable or an equivalent compatible cable.

settings.heading: A compact way to reach the places cloths miss.
settings.body: The included air nozzle helps direct airflow for car vents, window tracks, seats and dry dusty surfaces. Start at a lower setting and avoid blowing debris toward eyes, moving parts or electronics.
settings.image_alt: KP700 detailed cleaning of vents and window tracks

settings.heading: Clear clamp guidance before you start.
settings.body: The EC5 smart clamp uses a 10AWG cable and status/buzzer guidance. Its documented protection logic includes reverse polarity, short circuit, overcharge, over-discharge, over-current, overheating, high/low input voltage and timeout conditions.

settings.question: Which vehicles can KP700 support?
settings.answer: KP700 is for compatible 12V vehicle batteries, with a documented reference of up to 6.0L gasoline or 4.0L diesel engines. Do not attempt to jump-start a higher-rated engine or a battery with a different voltage.

settings.question: What does up to 25 starts mean?
settings.answer: The up-to-25-starts reference is based on the product documentation for a typical 1.5L passenger vehicle under a full charge. Results vary with engine size, battery condition, temperature and vehicle condition.

settings.question: How do I use KP700 to jump-start a vehicle?
settings.answer: Charge the unit to at least 50%, insert the clamp plug, connect red to the positive terminal and black to the negative terminal, wait for the green indication, then start the vehicle. Remove the clamps within 30 seconds after the vehicle starts.

settings.question: What are the three air-duster speeds?
settings.answer: The documented three levels are 30,000 RPM for up to 18 minutes, 70,000 RPM for up to 8 minutes and 100,000 RPM for up to 4.5 minutes. The maximum fan speed specification is 105,000 RPM (±10%).

settings.question: Can I charge a phone with KP700?
settings.answer: Yes. The USB-A output supports emergency device charging at 5V/2A. Recharge KP700 through its Type-C input at 5V/2A; typical recharge time is about four hours.

settings.question: What light modes are available?
settings.answer: The 2W LED has Steady, Flashing and SOS modes. Turn the unit on, then press the lighting key to move through the modes.

settings.question: Can I use KP700 in rain or rinse it clean?
settings.answer: No. Keep the unit, clamps and ports dry. The product is not marketed as waterproof or IP rated; do not rinse, submerge or use it when wet.
